validation_protocol: Fixed original 1024 targets and 256 targets per new book. Selection score = 0.5*original loss + 0.5*new-book macro loss.
test_protocol: Original reused holdout: all 16300 targets. Fresh expanded holdout: 2048 distinct targets/book; equal-book macro. First scored after all five checkpoint selections; neither test selects recipes or checkpoints.
limitation: Within-book held-out passages, imperfect OCR, one seed, unequal cumulative training, bundled data/depth changes. Exact-span audit is not semantic deduplication.
